column1: # 动画与音效测试版（src/fx/fx.js）的界面文字
测试版：存档与正式版分开保存，互不影响。主持人端的声音只在公开时刻出现（阶段、计时、事件、营救、公开结果）；屏幕共享带声音时大家都能听到。
column2: Beta: saves are kept apart from the regular version. On the host page, sounds only play at public moments (phases, timer, events, rescue, public results); if you share your screen with audio, everyone hears them.
